description: §55.5.2: a locked (no `let`) top-level value with validators, which nothing binds and no use site seeds, can never change — its validators are E-VALIDATOR-DEAD.
rationale: §55.5.2: "Validators on a value are dead — E-VALIDATOR-DEAD (§34), an error — only when nothing can ever change the value, which is when all three of the following hold and neither LIVE edge below applies: 1. no bind … 2. no write grant — the value is locked … 3. not server-loaded". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "validity calls 2-6" call 4.
